title: Flip AI Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Frontline Worker Communication Applications
summary: Flip AI has been named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Frontline Worker Communication Applications.
body_markdown:
For Flip AI, the recognition confirms what the category name hasn't caught up with: frontline work is no longer just about communication. The world's 2.7 billion frontline workers deserve more than a messaging tool. They deserve an operating system.


The Gartner Magic Quadrant for Frontline Worker Communication Applications is the first time Gartner has formally mapped this market, covering platforms that serve frontline workers worldwide, in industries including manufacturing, logistics, retail, healthcare and hospitality. It is a category built around communication, but communication is only the entry point of what Flip AI does.


"


“When we founded Flip AI in 2018, we set out to build technology for the 2.7 billion frontline workers around the world. Being named a Leader in Gartner's® first Magic Quadrant™ for Frontline Worker Communication Applications tells us we've earned our place in the market. But it also frames the question too narrowly. We were never building just a communication tool. We've built the only AI-native operating system for frontline work. The next chapter of this market won't be measured in messages. It'll be measured in who gets the work done.”


Benedikt Brand


CEO and Co-Founder of Flip AI


Flip AI's product line has grown far past its communications roots into the operating system for frontline work, bringing everything a frontline worker needs into one touch:[Frontline Identity](https://www.getflip.com/platform/identity-access-management/) , giving workers without a corporate email address secure access through passkeys, QR codes, invite codes and SSO;[Fusion](https://www.getflip.com/platform/ai-app-builder/) , an AI app builder that lets organizations build custom apps without engineering resources;[Flows](https://www.getflip.com/platform/workflow-engine/) , a workflow automation engine that digitizes everyday operational tasks; and the full communication experience, from the leading[communications suite](https://www.getflip.com/solutions/communications/) to AI-powered answers and agents in[Ask AI](https://www.getflip.com/features/ask-ai/) .


"


“2026 has been the year Flip AI stopped fitting into anyone's old category. We've shipped bigger features faster than ever before: Fusion, our AI app builder, AI-powered workflows, Frontline Identity and agents in Ask AI. Our customers can build apps for the way their frontline teams actually work, automate everyday tasks and give people the access and answers they need. We're honoured to be named a Leader in Gartner's® first Magic Quadrant™ for Frontline Worker Communication Applications. But the category will have to grow with us, because what we're building now is far bigger than communication.”


Luke Talbot


Chief Product and Technology Officer


Flip AI was founded in Stuttgart in 2018 and has since grown to more than 200 employees, with offices in Germany, the UK and the United States. The platform serves more than 1,000 enterprise brands and over two million users across frontline-intensive industries. Customers include GREIF, REWE Group, SIXT, TEDi, Bosch and FORVIA HELLA.


### **About Flip AI**


Flip AI is the leading AI-powered operating system for frontline organizations, bringing communications, workflows, digital identity and AI together in one app. More than two million frontline workers at companies including GREIF, REWE Group, SIXT, TEDi, Bosch and FORVIA HELLA use Flip AI to get access, information and tools without a corporate email address or a desk. Founded in Stuttgart in 2018, Flip AI has offices in Germany, the UK and the United States.
